{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Silk-blend blouse, relaxed fit with a soft pointed collar and long sleeves, hip-skimming length, dusty blue #a9c3da, matte crepe fabric

Straight-leg trousers, high-rise, ankle length with a pressed crease, charcoal #4a4f5a, fine wool blend

Single-breasted blazer, softly tailored, hip length, one-button, heather slate #5b6477, textured wool-blend bouclé tweed

Leather loafers, almond toe, low stacked heel, deep burgundy #6e2f3a, polished calf leather

Structured leather tote, medium size, deep burgundy #6e2f3a, smooth grain leather

Thin belt with a small silver buckle, silver #b8bcc4, smooth leather in charcoal #4a4f5a

Small stud earrings, round, pearl white #f2eee8, freshwater pearl

This outfit sits right in the neat business band: a blouse with tailored trousers, a textured jacket and loafers. The dusty blue blouse echoes her eye color and sits softly against her fair, cool-toned skin and silver-gray hair, while the charcoal and slate tones keep everything calm and harmonious. The ankle-length straight trousers and low heel give a long, uninterrupted line, and the hip-skimming jacket with the belted waistline keeps proportions balanced. The burgundy loafers and bag add a warm autumn accent, and no coat is needed since the textured blazer provides enough warmth for the season."}
